simple.summary: אֲרוּמָה (ʼĂrûwmâh) means Arumah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Judg 9 41.

definitions.full: H725. Arumah [ אֲרוּמָה ] proper name, of a location home of Abimelek (Thes Add below ארם ) Judg 9:41 בָּארוּמָה , probably = רוּמָה 2Kin 23:36 , compare Jerome Lag Onomast. 146, 2nd ed. 178 . It must have lain near Shechem; identified by MV and others with El `Ormah , 2 hours southeast from Shechem (van de Velde Reisen ii. 268 ), but this place not otherwise known; compare Survey ii. 387 .
